bias.label: Pressing the 3,697-3,706 cap; a 1H close above opens 3,738-3,798

event: Today, Fri 27 Nov: US half-day after Thanksgiving, thin trade into the close. Mon 30 Nov: month end. Tue 1 Dec: US ISM manufacturing and JOLTS (about 17:00 SAST, time UNVERIFIED). Thu 3 Dec: ISM services. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report, 15:30 SAST. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, with a 25 bp hike widely expected.

bullets.title: Rally extended
bullets.text: COMEX December gold was 3,688 at 14:29 SAST, up about 3.9% with a day high of 3,697.70 (Upstox), after spot hit 3,670.69 at 10:35 SAST (Reuters via Rallies).

bullets.title: Weekly gain, monthly loss
bullets.text: Spot is up about 3% on the week after Wednesday's low near 3,426, but gold is still heading for a third monthly fall (Ancstock, Longbridge).

bullets.title: Dollar has paused
bullets.text: The dollar index was about 103.73, off Monday's peak of 104.53, which gives gold some room (Upstox, Ancstock).

bullets.title: Hike still priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 96% chance of a December hike after core PCE of 3.3%, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.85%, so the main pressure on gold is still there.

bullets.title: Relief, not reversal
bullets.text: The bounce is tied to a pause in forced selling after the AI stock slump, and HSBC warns more stock losses could push gold below 3,400.

bullets.title: Physical demand firm
bullets.text: China's gold imports via Hong Kong hit their highest since April in October, and UBS says central banks are still buying.

bullets.title: At the big test
bullets.text: Price is now inside the 3,689-3,706 resistance zone while RoboForex still calls the daily trend bearish, so this is where the bounce breaks out or fails.

buy.title: Buy plan: pullback to 3,651-3,671 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is against the bigger daily downtrend, so use half size or skip it.
A slow pullback into 3,651-3,671 with long lower wicks, not a fast drop through it.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,675.
The dollar index staying under 103.80 and US yields not rising.
Take some profit at 3,685 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying now at 3,685, right under resistance. Wait for the pullback or a clean 1H close above 3,706.
A 1H close under 3,645 means the breakout has failed and 3,600-3,606 is next. Step aside.
The US half-day close can bring sharp moves in thin trade. Keep size small.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That turns a small loss into a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rally fails at 3,697-3,706 (with the main trend)
look: Price pushes into 3,697-3,706 and stalls near today's 3,697.70 high.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,685.
A 1H lower high under 3,706 with momentum fading.
The dollar or US yields firming again, which fits the Fed hike pricing.
Take some profit at 3,671 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling into strength before any rejection shows. Wait for the wick or the close back under 3,685.
A 1H close above 3,712 means the bounce is stronger and 3,738-3,798 is next. Do not fight it.
Fed, tariff or Middle East headlines can move price fast in thin holiday trade.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
